summary: ConnectM Technology Solutions filed an 8-K reporting its July 1, 2026 acquisition of a 60% controlling interest in Blue Ribbon Ice Inc., a commercial HVAC and refrigeration services platform, from Scott Avery Wilson. The consideration comprised 58,824 shares of ConnectM common stock and $250,000 cash. No premium, deal value, or advisor is disclosed. The acquired business will join ConnectM's AI-Powered Logistics platform alongside its existing DeliveryCircle business. The target's shares were acquired free of liens, and the buyer's shares were issued unregistered. Key watch point: integration execution and potential dilution impact from the stock issuance.
